issues: starter/scheduler.py contains explicit 'BUG:' comments that reveal exact bug locations and nature (transitive cancel, any vs all, heap key, token refill cap, burst check), trivializing the debugging task
spec mentions FAILED state but never defines how it is entered, leaving state-machine underspecified
grader does not verify that RUNNING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED are terminal for cancellation - reference solution cancels RUNNING yet passes all tests
grader does not test token-bucket capacity capping after idle period or elapsed-time refill, only basic burst cases
dependency_checks O(V+E) requirement only tested on a linear completion chain, not on cancellation propagation, allowing inefficient implementations to pass
prompt is not self-contained and delegates full contract to starter docstring, making task ambiguous in isolation
summary: Starter leaks bug locations and grader misses key invariants (RUNNING non-cancellable, token cap, FAILED) allowing spec-violating solution to pass.
